Frequently Asked Questions

Is COMSATS better than QAU?

Both COMSATS University Islamabad and Quaid-i-Azam University are HEC-recognized universities. COMSATS is public (est. 1998) in Islamabad / Lahore / Wah / Attock / Sahiwal / Vehari / Abbottabad, while QAU is public (est. 1967) in Islamabad. The better choice depends on your field, budget, and merit — compare the details above.

What is the fee difference between COMSATS and QAU?

COMSATS's fee is approximately Rs. 1.46–1.6L/sem per semester, while QAU's is Rs. 60–80K/sem. See the full comparison above.

What is the merit for COMSATS and QAU?

COMSATS: UG: 50% NTS NAT + 40% FSc + 10% Matric. MS: 40% GAT + 25% BS + 20% interview + 10% Inter + 5% Matric.. QAU: Merit on academic record (≈30% Matric + 70% HSSC) with strict provincial/regional quotas. LLB needs LAT; MPhil/PhD need GAT/subject test + interview..
